en.question:
I control both <<6000>> and <<5020>> and the『You choose the attack targets for your opponent's attacks』effect of <<5020>> is applying.

In this situation, if my opponent's <<5381>> attacks, can I choose <<6000>> as the attack target multiple times?
en.title: Can the effect of <<5020>> be used to make a monster that can『attack all monsters your opponent controls once each』attack the same monster multiple times?
